limits: Only Europe PMC's open-access subset has full text; figures are their captions and tables are left out.
bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Relays the remote service's own result unchanged; it computes no number of its own, so the service is the authority for what comes back.
bio.jane/contract.question: Give me this paper's open-access full text.

description: Fetch a paper's whole open-access text from Europe PMC by PMCID or PMID: title, authors, journal, license, abstract, every section and every figure caption, as Markdown. This is how a pipeline reads a paper rather than its abstract; pass the Markdown to find_accessions for the records it names. Only Europe PMC's open-access subset is served, and an article outside it is refused with Europe PMC's own reason.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

id.description: the PMCID (PMC13627669) or PMID (39012345) of the paper.

name: fetch_article

license.description: the article's own license statement, as the publisher wrote it

markdown.description: the whole article as Markdown, figure references linked to their captions

pmcid.description: the PMCID Europe PMC served it under
